Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the data retrieved in the previous step. While the WebSurfer correctly identified H. Bruce Humberstone's birth date as November 18, 1901, the Planner erroneously recorded it as "November 18, 2001" in their analysis. This transcription error led to the incorrect conclusion that Lucio Fulci (born 1927) was born earlier than Humberstone, when in fact Humberstone (born 1901) was born earlier.
